description_en: Queries the DNS records of a site, including record values, priorities, and authentication configurations. Supports filtering by record name, record type, and other conditions
description_zh: 查询站点下解析记录列表，包括记录值、优先级、认证配置等。支持根据记录名称、记录类型等条件进行过滤
name: ListRecords

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can obtain the site ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The record name. This parameter is used as a filter condition for the query
parameters.help_zh: 记录名称。用于查询的过滤条件
parameters.name: record_name

parameters.help_en:
The search match mode for the record name. Default value: exact. Valid values:

prefix: prefix match
suffix: suffix match
exact: exact match
fuzzy: fuzzy match
parameters.help_zh:
记录名称的搜索匹配模式。默认为精确匹配，取值：

prefix：前缀匹配。
suffix：后缀匹配。
exact：精确匹配。
fuzzy：模糊匹配
parameters.name: record_match_type

parameters.help_en: The page number for paging. The value must be greater than or equal to 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，第几页，取值大于等于 1。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paging. Valid values: 1 to 500. Default value: 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页大小，取值范围 1-500。默认值：500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The origin server type of the record. This parameter is used as a filter condition for the query. Only CNAME records can be filtered by this field. Valid values:
OSS: OSS origin server
S3: S3 origin server
LB: load balancing origin server
OP: IPAM pool origin server
Domain: regular domain name origin server
parameters.help_zh:
记录的源站类型，用于查询的过滤条件（仅CNAME记录可以通过该字段筛选），取值：
OSS：OSS源站。
S3：S3源站。
LB：负载均衡器源站。
OP：源地址池源站。
Domain：普通域名源站
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en:
The business scenario for record acceleration. This parameter is used as a filter condition for the query. Valid values:
image_video: images and videos
api: APIs
web: web pages
parameters.help_zh:
记录加速时的业务场景，用于查询的过滤条件，取值：
image_video：视频图片。
api：api接口。
web：web网页
parameters.name: biz_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether proxy acceleration is enabled for the record. This parameter is used as a filter condition for the query. Valid values:

true: Proxy acceleration is enabled.
false: Proxy acceleration is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
记录是否开启代理加速，用于查询的过滤条件。取值：

true：开启代理。
false：关闭代理加速
parameters.name: proxied

parameters.help_en: The DNS record type of the record. This parameter is used as a filter condition for the query
parameters.help_zh: 记录的DNS记录类型，用于查询的过滤条件
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether a custom port is enabled for the record. Valid values:

on: enabled
off: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
记录是否开启自定义端口。取值范围：

on：开启。
off：未开启
parameters.name: custom_port

PageNumber.description_en: The current page number. The value is the same as the PageNumber request parameter
PageNumber.description_zh: 当前页码，同请求参数的 PageNumber

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

Records.description_en: The DNS information of the records. For more information, see <props="china">[Documentation]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2708761.html）</props><props="intl">Documentation (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/doc-detail/2708761.html)</props>
Records.description_zh: 记录的DNS信息，详情请参考<props="china">[说明文档]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2708761.html）</props><props="intl">说明文档 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/doc-detail/2708761.html)</props>

items.description_en: The information about a single record

AuthConf.description_en: The origin server authentication information of the CNAME record

AccessKey.description_en: The AccessKey ID of the account to which the origin server belongs. This parameter is returned when the origin server type is OSS and the origin server authentication type is private read across accounts, or when the origin server type is S3 and the origin server authentication type is private read
AccessKey.description_zh: 源站所属账号的AccessKey，当源站类型为OSS且源站鉴权类型为私有跨账号读，或者源站类型为S3且源站鉴权类型为私有读时有该参数

AuthType.description_en:
The origin server authentication type. Different origin server types support different authentication types. The origin server type refers to the SourceType parameter in this operation. When the origin server type is OSS or S3, you must specify the origin server authentication type. Valid values:
public: Public read. This value is used when the origin server type is OSS or S3 and the origin server allows public read access.
private: Private read. This value is used when the origin server type is S3 and the origin server allows private read access.
private_same_account: Private read within the same account. This value is used when the origin server type is OSS, the origin server and the current service are within the same Alibaba Cloud account, and the origin server allows private read access.
private_cross_account: Private read across accounts. This value is used when the origin server type is OSS, the origin server and the current service are within different Alibaba Cloud accounts, and the origin server allows private read access
AuthType.description_zh:
源站鉴权类型，不同的源站类型，支持的鉴权类型不同，源站类型是指本接口中的SourceType参数，现在源站类型为OSS和S3时，需要填写源站鉴权类型，可选值：
public：公共读，当源站类型为OSS或S3，且源站为公共读时为该参数。
private: 私有读，当源站类型为S3，且源站为私有读时为该参数。
private_same_account: 私有同账号读，当源站类型为OSS，在同一个阿里云账号下，且源站为私有读时为该参数。
private_cross_account: 私有跨账号读，当源站类型为OSS，不在同一个阿里云账号下，且源站为私有读时为该参数

Region.description_en: The region to which the origin server belongs. This parameter is returned when the origin server type is S3. You can obtain the region information from the official website of S3
Region.description_zh: 源站所属区域，当源站类型为S3时有该参数，源站所属的区域需要在S3的官方网站上获取

SecretKey.description_en: The AccessKey secret of the account to which the origin server belongs. This parameter is returned when the origin server type is OSS and the origin server authentication type is private read across accounts, or when the origin server type is S3 and the origin server authentication type is private read
SecretKey.description_zh: 源站所属账号的SecretKey，当源站类型为OSS且源站鉴权类型为私有跨账号读，或者源站类型为S3且源站鉴权类型为私有读时有该参数

Version.description_en:
The signature algorithm version. This parameter is returned when the origin server type is S3 and the origin server authentication type is private read. Valid values:
v2
v4

If this parameter is not specified, the default value is v4
Version.description_zh:
签名算法版本，当源站类型为S3且源站鉴权类型为私有读时有该参数，支持以下两种：
v2
v4

不传时，默认为v4

BizName.description_en:
The business scenario for record acceleration. Valid values:
image_video: images and videos
api: APIs
web: web pages
BizName.description_zh:
记录加速时的业务场景，取值：
image_video：视频图片。
api：api接口。
web：web网页

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the record. The time is displayed in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format
CreateTime.description_zh: 记录的创建时间，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

CustomPort.description_en:
Specifies whether a custom port is enabled for the record. Valid values:

on: enabled
off: disabled
CustomPort.description_zh:
记录是否开启自定义端口。取值范围：

on：开启。
off：未开启

Data.description_en: The specific DNS information of the record. Different types of records contain different information
Data.description_zh: 记录的具体DNS信息。不同类型记录包含不同的信息

Algorithm.description_en: The encryption algorithm used by the record. Valid values: 0 to 255. This parameter is exclusive to CERT and SSHFP records
Algorithm.description_zh: 记录所采用的加密算法，范围为0~255。CERT、SSHFP记录独有

Certificate.description_en: The public key certificate information of the record. This parameter is exclusive to CERT, SMIMEA, and TLSA records
Certificate.description_zh: 记录的公钥证书信息。CERT、SMIMEA和TLSA记录独有

Fingerprint.description_en: The public key fingerprint value of the record. This parameter is exclusive to SSHFP records
Fingerprint.description_zh: 记录的公钥指纹值。SSHFP记录独有

Flag.description_en: The flag of the record. For CAA records, the flag indicates the priority and processing method. Valid values: 0 to 255. This parameter is exclusive to CAA records
Flag.description_zh: 记录的标志位。CAA记录的Flag指示其优先级和处理方式，取值范围为0~255。CAA记录独有

KeyTag.description_en: The public key tag of the record. Valid values: 0 to 65535. This parameter is exclusive to CERT records
KeyTag.description_zh: 记录的公钥标识，范围为0~65535。CERT记录独有

MatchingType.description_en: The algorithm policy used by the record to match or verify the certificate. Valid values: 0 to 255. This parameter is exclusive to SMIMEA and TLSA records
MatchingType.description_zh: 记录用于匹配或验证证书的算法策略，范围为0~255。SMIMEA和TLSA记录独有

Port.description_en: The port of the record. Valid values: 0 to 65535. This parameter is exclusive to SRV records
Port.description_zh: 记录的端口，范围为0~65535。SRV记录独有

Priority.description_en: The priority of the record. Valid values: 0 to 65535. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. This parameter is exclusive to MX, SRV, and URI records
Priority.description_zh: 记录的优先级，范围为 0~65535。数值越小，优先级越高。MX、SRV、URI记录独有

Selector.description_en: The type of the certificate or public key used by the record. Valid values: 0 to 255. This parameter is exclusive to SMIMEA and TLSA records
Selector.description_zh: 记录所使用的证书或公钥的类型，范围为0~255。SMIMEA和TLSA记录独有

Tag.description_en: The tag of the record. For CAA records, the tag indicates the specific type and usage. This parameter is exclusive to CAA records
Tag.description_zh: 记录的标签。CAA记录的Tag表示其具体类型和用途。CAA记录独有

Type.description_en: The certificate type of the record in CERT records, or the public key type in SSHFP records
Type.description_zh: 记录的证书类型（在CERT记录中），或公钥类型（在SSHFP记录中）

Usage.description_en: The usage identifier of the record. Valid values: 0 to 255. This parameter is exclusive to SMIMEA and TLSA records
Usage.description_zh: 记录的用途标识，范围为0~255。SMIMEA和TLSA记录独有

Value.description_en:
The record value or partial content. This parameter is included in A, AAAA, CNAME, NS, MX, TXT, CAA, SRV, and URI records. It indicates different meanings in different types of records:

A/AAAA: The destination IP address. If multiple IP addresses are specified, separate them with commas (,). At least one IPv4 address is required.
CNAME: The destination domain name.
NS: The name server of the specified domain name.
MX: The valid destination mail server domain name.
TXT: The valid text string.
CAA: The valid certification authority domain name.
SRV: The valid destination host domain name.
URI: The valid URI string
Value.description_zh:
记录值或部分内容。A/AAAA、CNAME、NS、MX、TXT、CAA、SRV、URI记录含有该参数。在不同类型的记录中，分别表示不同的含义：

A/AAAA：指向的ip地址。多个ip时，用半角逗号,分隔。至少需要有一个ipv4地址。
CNAME：指向的目标域名。
NS：指定域名的名称服务器。
MX:  有效的目标邮件服务器域名。
TXT：有效的文本字符串。
CAA：有效的证书颁发机构域名。
SRV：有效的目标主机域名。
URI: 有效的 URI 字符串

Weight.description_en: The weight of the record. Valid values: 0 to 65535. This parameter is exclusive to SRV and URI records
Weight.description_zh: 记录的权重，范围为0~65535。SRV、URI记录独有

HostPolicy.description_en:
The back-to-origin host policy. This policy takes effect when the record type is CNAME. Settings for the host policy in back-to-origin requests include two patterns:

follow_hostname: follow the request host
follow_origin_domain: follow the Origin Domain Name
HostPolicy.description_zh:
回源HOST策略，记录类型为CNAME时生效，设置回源时带HOST的策略，有两种模式：

follow_hostname: 跟随请求HOST。
follow_origin_domain: 跟随源站域名

HttpPorts.description_en: The HTTP port. Port 80 is supported by default
HttpPorts.description_zh: Http 端口，默认支持 80 端口

HttpsPorts.description_en: The HTTPS port. Port 443 is supported by default
HttpsPorts.description_zh: Https 端口，默认支持 443 端口

Proxied.description_en:
Specifies whether proxy acceleration is enabled for the record. Valid values:

true: Proxy acceleration is enabled.
false: Proxy acceleration is disabled
Proxied.description_zh:
记录是否开启代理加速。取值：

true：开启代理。
false：关闭代理加速

RecordCname.description_en: The CNAME of the record. If the site is onboarded by using CNAME access, you must configure this CNAME value for the record
RecordCname.description_zh: 记录的CNAME。当站点的接入方式为CNAME接入时，需要为记录配置的CNAME值

RecordSourceType.description_en:
The origin server type of the CNAME record. This parameter is required when you add a CNAME record. Valid values:

OSS: OSS origin server
S3: S3 origin server
LB: load balancing origin server
OP: IPAM pool origin server
Domain: regular domain name origin server

If this parameter is not specified or is left empty, the default value is Domain, which indicates a regular domain name origin server
RecordSourceType.description_zh:
CNAME记录的源站类型。添加CNAME记录时，需要填写此参数。取值：

OSS：OSS源站。
S3：S3源站。
LB：负载均衡器源站。
OP：源地址池源站。
Domain：普通域名源站。

该参数不传或传空时，则默认为Domain，即普通域名源站类型

RecordType.description_en: The DNS type of the record, such as A/AAAA, CNAME, or TXT

SiteId.description_en: The ID of the site to which the record belongs

SiteName.description_en: The name of the site to which the record belongs

Ttl.description_en: The time-to-live (TTL) of the record, in seconds. A value of 1 indicates that the TTL is automatic
Ttl.description_zh: 记录的过期时间，单位秒。当取值为1时，表示记录的过期时间为自动

UpdateTime.description_en: The update time of the record. The time is displayed in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format
UpdateTime.description_zh: 记录的更新时间，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
